name: Mossy Hollow

rules.rule: Mossy Hollow is hidden by ordinary old-growth geography, mist, and tree cover—not a magical barrier.
rules.story_effect: Humans may be a distant curiosity but are never pursuers or horror threats.

rules.rule: Physical comedy may stretch reality when setup, direction, and consequences remain visually clear.
rules.story_effect: Falls and collisions stay mild; practical and emotional cleanup still matters.

rules.rule: Overt magic is rare and ambiguous; wonder usually comes from nature, imagination, playful forest science, or mystery.
rules.story_effect: Magic cannot arrive without setup to solve a plot.

rules.rule: Technology is tactile, understandable, repairable, and built from wood, fiber, stone, simple metal, water, and reused objects.
rules.story_effect: Screens and unexplained advanced devices do not solve stories.

rules.rule: There are no irredeemable villains in ordinary episodes; conflict comes from choices, clashing goals, nature, and misunderstandings.
rules.story_effect: Opponents retain dignity and can participate in repair.

rules.rule: Emotional growth and established facts persist gently while each episode remains accessible to first-time viewers.
rules.story_effect: Lasting changes are recorded in the series bible and continuity log.

rules.rule: Every character in the world is always barefoot or has uncovered natural bare paws.
rules.story_effect: No footwear exists on characters, including in crowds, fantasy play, weather scenes, uniforms, or sports.

safety_boundaries: No horror framing, disturbing transformations, threatening pursuit, graphic injury, or cruel punishment.
No child is abandoned, trapped in realistic danger, or made responsible for adult emotional stability.
Food and environmental messes are cleaned or repaired rather than treated as consequence-free waste.
